description: This file defines a 'SearchBar' UI component using the Lightning.js framework. It includes properties for sizing, placeholders, styling, and input handling, with methods for setting value, focusing, and blurring the component. The component renders a visual search bar with icons and text, and handles keyboard input for search queries.

classes.name: SearchBar
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing a customizable search bar with input handling and styled visuals.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Set query text programmatically and update visuals.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the component and start capturing text input.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Blur the component; input bubbles up.
